segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on and countdown, announces his penis is back.

segments.title: Jimmy Kimmel Monologue Reaction
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and Jeff Ripple watch and dissect Jimmy Kimmel's 20-minute return monologue addressing the Trump/Disney free speech controversy, Ted Cruz's defense, and Erica Kirk's forgiveness statement.

segments.title: Kendall Walk-Through
segments.notes: Kendelle crosses the studio frame with signature theme music; brief domestic check-in about dinner plans and Only Murders in the Building critique.

segments.title: Crum Resurrection & Points Dispute
segments.notes: Crum returns from hell with amnesia; Munch confronts him over the gorilla wager, points ledger, Beyblade tournament scheduling, and a debate on whether Crum had sex with Hitler in hell.

segments.title: BIN Town Hall with Marfus Darfus & Chet
segments.notes: Marfus Darfus and Chet field viewer questions via !TH command; topics include Gizbo wall repairs, Texas cardinal direction 'Touth', Arizona heat, Grandman rescue, Fed rates, weed legalization, and Hate Sock.

segments.title: Grandma Crumble Bottom & The Lanky Box Discovery
segments.notes: Grandma Crumble Bottom joins Case for viral video review; they uncover the 'Lanky Box' children's content rabbit hole (Goo Goo Gaga, baby-fetish animation) and a palate-cleanser cheeseburger slap video.

segments.title: Raid & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Case raids Ovali with 'Lanky Box' spam; announces Friday return and Patreon stream with Kassim.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: lead anchor. Anchors the broadcast, reacts to Kimmel monologue, moderates Munch & Crum and Town Hall, hosts Amongst the Web with Grandma.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold open sign-on and countdown; mentions snap camera filter reset.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosts News desk during Kimmel watch; banters about Hype Train emanating from him.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype correspondent. Brief freestyle rap thanking subs; claims marriage to Crum in hell; exits to file divorce papers.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walk-through with theme music; discusses dinner plans and Selena Gomez/Benny Blanco critique.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Returns from hell with amnesia; disputes points ledger with Munch; claims super strength and baby-sized penis post-resurrection.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Confronts Crum over resurrection, points, and Beyblade tournament; accuses Crum of hell orgy with Hitler.

characters.name: Marfus Darfus
characters.notes: town hall guest. Fields viewer questions at Town Hall; claims 'reparded strength' and Marshal of BIN Halloween Parade title.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Participates in Town Hall; claims to be a 'skintist'; commits to rescuing Grandman from the wall tomorrow.

storylines.beat: Crum resurrected from hell after gorilla explosion; Munch demands points return; Crum claims amnesia and super strength; Beyblade tournament re-pledged for Friday [1:20:22-1:42:23].
Beyblades lost in move; new sub goal for Beyblade battle to be created Friday [1:28:35].

storylines.storyline: Peter Gibbon / Grandman in the Wall
storylines.beat: Town Hall question asks if Peter and Grandman dead; Marfus assumes Peter dead, Grandman unkillable; Chet commits to wall rescue mission [1:51:55, 1:54:50].

lore_notes.fact: Penis hairless and baby-sized for 48 hours post-resurrection; returned to normal 'big but unpleasant' [1:25:57].
Claims super strength: pulling doors off hinges without gym training [1:25:13].
Ran hell transit system while deceased [1:36:03].
Claims 'reparded strength' from high school; upper body strength sufficient to defend against killers [1:51:08].
Self-appointed Marshal of the BIN Halloween Parade; proposes October 2 date [1:59:59].
Identifies as a 'skintist' (scientist); scientifically proven one of smartest guys ever [1:53:16].
Claims vibe of being 16 in 1982 but not actual age; been lost since 1982 [2:07:43].

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a late start to dissect Jimmy Kimmel's emotional return monologue on free speech and Disney pressure. Crum reappears after a summer in hell with amnesia, a hairless baby penis, and newfound super strength, sparking a points dispute with Munch and a Beyblade tournament re-commitment. The revived Town Hall segment debuts with Marfus Darfus and Chet fielding chaotic viewer questions, culminating in a Grandman wall-rescue pledge. Grandma Crumble Bottom joins Amongst the Web to uncover the unsettling 'Lanky Box' children's content empire before the broadcast raids Ovali with baby-rot spam.
